Morolic acid, a compound with known pharmacological activity, is implicated in the interaction with Jurkat cells. This chain of targets implies that fluticasone may exert its effects through a pathway involving morolic acid, which then interacts with Jurkat cells. The integration of these targets suggests a possible mechanism by which fluticasone influences Jurkat cells, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
